attributes.name: Milford McGuirt
attributes.blurb: Retired Managing Partner, Atlanta Office and Mid-South Area, KPMG
attributes.summary: McGuirt served as managing partner of the Atlanta office and mid-south region of KPMG until his retirement. Additionally, he was KPMG's national audit sector leader and national industry leader for the firm's higher education practice. He spent more than 41 years in public accounting and audit services to a wide range of public and private companies.
